title: Heroes' Vigil

[[Image:Heroes' Vigil.jpg|thumb|300px|Heroes' Vigil]]

'''Heroes' Vigil''' is the central area of the [[Stone Cairn Lake]] island in eastern [[Elwynn Forest]]. It features a ring of stones, and a monument called the [[Stone of Remembrance]] which commemorates the dead from the orcs' sacking of [[Goldshire]] and other nearby regions during the [[First War]]. The island itself is controlled by [[Defias Rogue Wizard]]s who can be dangerous to inexperienced adventurers, as well as the rogue Defias mage [[Ralthas]], who fled to Heroes' Vigil after stealing the [[Necklace of Azora]] from the [[Tower of Azora]].

The body of [[Henze Faulk]] is situated here.
